name: slow-regen-runs
description: Repeat of final-runs (headless/experiments/final_runs.json) with the soil regen chance below 1% per tick: 0.01, 0.025, 0.05, 0.1 (% per tick; soilRegenRate is already a percentage, so 0.05 means 0.05%, not 5%). Everything else identical to final-runs. This file is the nocost set: claws can evolve, burrowing is free for the soil (hideFertilityCost 0): 15 maps (5 soil seeds x 3 layouts) x 4 regen chances x 3 replicates = 180 runs. The three sets (slow_regen_main/noclaw/nocost.json) write to the same folder, Observations/slow-regen-runs/, so they can run in parallel on different machines and be merged afterwards.
